summary: Three-persona system (Analyst + Executive + Consultant), framework components, golden matrix

changes.description: Consultant persona — framework-first design for deliverables that earn trust through methodology and survive forwarding without a presenter
benchmark-comparison component — horizontal bars with benchmark markers and gap badges for positioning against industry/peer data
maturity-model component — 3-5 stage ordinal scale with 'you are here' and target position markers
quadrant-matrix component — 2×2 positioning grid with labeled axes and focal/neutral item discipline
Golden matrix structure — 10 goldens planned across 3 personas × key archetypes, plus 4 anti-goldens
Consultant-specific regression prompts (#10 benchmark, #11 maturity, #12 positioning)
Every prompt now produces 3 slides (was 2 in v4)
Personas routing tables expanded to include consultant visual/chart/findings/evidence forks
Color system section restructured — analyst (semantic), executive (brand), consultant (brand + benchmark markers)
Canvas size inconsistency resolved — contract §1 said 1920×1080 but §4 and SKILL.md said 1280×720. All now consistently 1280×720
Phantom tokens.css reference fixed — SKILL.md pointed to components/tokens.css which doesn't exist; now correctly references :root block in slide-shell.html
LEARNINGS.md cleaned — 25+ promoted rules collapsed into folded details block, 1 active rule retained
Consultant-specific bans in slide contract §7: generic methodology slides, same-quadrant matrices, unsourced benchmarks
